claim_verdicts.evidence: Caddy reverse_proxy: "By default, Caddy passes through incoming headers" (exceptions: X-Forwarded-For/-Proto/-Host). Gateway API TLS guide: TLS mode defaults to Terminate; gateway.yaml sets mode: Terminate on the https listener. The HTTPRoutes have no filters, so Traefik's opt-in RequestHeaderModifier is not in use. Round 2 text matches the round-1 suggested_text and no longer claims Traefik behaviour beyond that.

ASP.NET Core docs, JWT bearer: "JWT bearer tokens should be fully validated in an API. The following should be validated: Signature ... Issuer claim ... Audience claim ... Token expiration." and "The public key is available in the well known endpoints and the API clients can validate the signature of the access token using the public key." JwtBearerOptions.AutomaticRefreshInterval: "Gets or sets how often an automatic metadata refresh should occur."

K8s docs: namespaceSelector "selects particular namespaces for which all Pods should be allowed as ingress sources"; control plane sets immutable label kubernetes.io/metadata.name. network-policies.yaml: default-deny-ingress podSelector {}; from-the-gateway namespaceSelector traefik, port 8080. Working tree: no other policy in the file selects app api or payments, so section 5's "no other Pod may connect" holds. Values [api, payments] at stage-3 inferred from the file's "From stage-4" comment.

K8s docs: NetworkPolicies control traffic "at the IP address or port level (OSI layer 3 or 4)"; "traffic to and from the node where a Pod is running is always allowed"; "Creating a NetworkPolicy resource without a controller that implements it will have no effect." Round 2 section 4 states both conditions (enforcing plugin, node traffic always allowed), as suggested in round 1.

JwtBearerOptions.Audience: "Gets or sets a single valid audience value for any received OpenIdConnect token. This value is passed into TokenValidationParameters.ValidAudience if that property is empty." Docs: "If any of these claims or values are incorrect, the API should return a 401 response". Payments: RoleClaimType = "roles"; AddPolicy("StaffOnly", policy => policy.RequireRole("staff")).
